# The library's methods: what page code and story tests may call

Every method below is declared in `com/xoveconsulting/tests/core/`, with exactly these parameters.
**Call only a method you have seen declared**, here or in its class, with arguments of those types:
a call written from memory is the most common way new code fails to compile, and the suite's rules,
which read the sources, cannot see it. When you cannot run `mvn`, check every call you wrote
against this card before you say you are done, and say that the code was not compiled.

A `PageElement` is a constant of a page's Elements enum (`HomeElements.ABOUT_LINK`); `page` is
the page object's browser session.

## UserActions

- `UserActions.click(Page page, PageElement element)`: Clicks it.
- `UserActions.clickOpeningNewTab(Page page, PageElement element)` returns `Page`: Clicks something that opens a new tab, and returns the tab; the next page object lives there.
- `UserActions.hover(Page page, PageElement element)`: Points the mouse at it (a menu that opens on hover, a tooltip).
- `UserActions.type(Page page, PageElement element, String text)`: Replaces what is in the field with this text.
- `UserActions.typeSecret(Page page, PageElement element, String secret)`: Types a password or other secret. The step says a secret was typed, never what it was.
- `UserActions.clear(Page page, PageElement element)`: Empties the field.
- `UserActions.choose(Page page, PageElement element, String option)`: Chooses an option of a dropdown (a select element) by its value or its visible text.
- `UserActions.tick(Page page, PageElement element)`: Ticks a checkbox or picks a radio button.
- `UserActions.untick(Page page, PageElement element)`: Unticks a checkbox.
- `UserActions.setTicked(Page page, PageElement element, boolean ticked)`: Ticks or unticks: what a page's check() and uncheck() actions call.
- `UserActions.pressKey(Page page, PageElement element, String key)`: Presses a key in it: "Enter", "Tab", "Escape", "ArrowDown".
- `UserActions.readText(Page page, PageElement element)` returns `String`: Reads the text a visitor sees in it, trimmed. The step says what it read.

## Checks

- `Checks.isShown(Page page, PageElement element)`: It is shown.
- `Checks.isNotShown(Page page, PageElement element)`: It is gone, or hidden.
- `Checks.allShown(Page page, String what, PageElement... elements)`: All of them are shown: one step, and the failure names the first one missing.
- `Checks.hasText(Page page, PageElement element, String expected)`: It says exactly this (runs of spaces and line breaks count as one space).
- `Checks.hasValue(Page page, PageElement element, String expected)`: A field holds exactly this: what was typed into it (a field has no text of its own to read).
- `Checks.containsText(Page page, PageElement element, String expected)`: Its text contains this.
- `Checks.pageShowsText(Page page, String text)`: The page shows this text somewhere a visitor can see it (any case; part of a longer text is fine).
- `Checks.hasCount(Page page, String what, Locator all, int expected)`: The page shows this many of them. A page element's locator stops at the first match, so this takes the locator of all of them: page.locator("css=ul.results > li"). Hidden ones (a mobile menu's copies) are not counted.
- `Checks.isEnabled(Page page, PageElement element)`: It is shown, and can be used (a button or field that is not disabled).
- `Checks.isDisabled(Page page, PageElement element)`: It is shown, and disabled.
- `Checks.isChecked(Page page, PageElement element)`: A checkbox or radio button is shown, and ticked.
- `Checks.isNotChecked(Page page, PageElement element)`: A checkbox or radio button is shown, and not ticked.
- `Checks.hasAttribute(Page page, PageElement element, String name, String expected)`: Its attribute holds exactly this: hasAttribute(page, HELP_LINK, "href", "/help").
- `Checks.isOnPath(Page page, String path)`: The browser is on this path of the site.
- `Checks.titleIs(Page page, String title)`: The page's title is exactly this.

## WaitActions

- `WaitActions.seconds(long ms)` returns `String`: A wait as a person reads it: "10" (seconds), or "0.5".
- `WaitActions.elementTimeout()` returns `long`: (no description: read it in its class)
- `WaitActions.shortenWaits(Long millis)`: For HarnessTest only: checks it makes fail on purpose fail in half a second, not ten. For this thread, until shortenWaits(null). A real test never shortens its waits.
- `WaitActions.waitForUrl(Page page, String path)` returns `boolean`: Waits for the browser to be on exactly this path of the site (query and #fragment aside).
- `WaitActions.waitForUrlShape(Page page, List<String> shapes)` returns `boolean`: Waits for a URL of one of these shapes, e.g. "/blog/*": "*" is one path segment, "{n}" a number.
- `WaitActions.stillLoading(Page page)` returns `List<String>`: What the page is still loading (frames, media, images) when its load event is late: shown with the note below, so a slow third party is named instead of failing a page that is there.
- `WaitActions.noteStillLoading(Page page, String name)`: Says that a page proven by its address, title and checks had not finished loading in time, and what held it.
- `WaitActions.waitForPageLoad(Page page)` returns `boolean`: Waits until the page and everything it loads has finished loading (the load event).
- `WaitActions.waitForTitle(Page page, String title)` returns `boolean`: Waits for exactly this title (runs of whitespace count as one space).
- `WaitActions.waitForTitle(Page page, String startsWith, String endsWith)` returns `boolean`: Waits for a title that starts and ends like this (the page's own name goes in between).
- `WaitActions.waitForVisibilityOf(Page page, PageElement element)` returns `boolean`: Waits until the element is visible.
- `WaitActions.waitForVisibilityOf(Page page, PageElement element, long timeoutMs)` returns `boolean`: Waits up to timeoutMs until the element is visible.
- `WaitActions.waitForPresenceOf(Page page, PageElement element)` returns `boolean`: Waits until the element is in the page, visible or not.
- `WaitActions.waitForInvisibilityOf(Page page, PageElement element)` returns `boolean`: Waits until the element is gone or hidden: a spinner, an overlay, a "Loading..." message.
- `WaitActions.waitForInvisibilityOf(Page page, PageElement element, long timeoutMs)` returns `boolean`: Waits up to timeoutMs until the element is gone or hidden.
- `WaitActions.until(BooleanSupplier ready, long timeoutMs)` returns `boolean`: Waits up to timeoutMs until the condition holds, checking every tenth of a second.
- `WaitActions.samePage(String url, String expectedUrl)` returns `boolean`: True when both URLs are the same page: same site and path; query, #fragment and a final "/" aside.
- `WaitActions.fitsShapes(String url, List<String> shapes)` returns `boolean`: True when the URL's path has one of these shapes.
- `WaitActions.fitsShape(String url, String shape)` returns `boolean`: True when the URL's path has this shape: "*" is any one segment, "{n}" a number.
- `WaitActions.sameTitle(String title, String expected)` returns `boolean`: (no description: read it in its class)
- `WaitActions.sameText(String text, String expected)` returns `boolean`: True when both say the same, whatever the spacing: runs of whitespace count as one space.
- `WaitActions.containsText(String text, String expected)` returns `boolean`: True when the text contains the expected words, whatever the spacing.
- `WaitActions.titleFits(String title, String startsWith, String endsWith)` returns `boolean`: (no description: read it in its class)

## SiteConfig

- `SiteConfig.baseUrl()` returns `String`: (no description: read it in its class)
- `SiteConfig.url(String path)` returns `String`: The full URL of a path on the site under test, e.g. url("/about").
- `SiteConfig.secret(String name)` returns `String`: A secret a test needs (a password, an API key): from -Dname=... or the environment variable NAME (upper case; dots and dashes become underscores). Fails, saying how to pass it, when neither is set. Secrets never go into the code, a saved page or a log.
- `SiteConfig.value(String name, String fallback)` returns `String`: Test data that may differ between copies of the site (a product that exists on staging, say): from -Dname=... or the environment variable NAME, else the fallback.
- `SiteConfig.searchTerm()` returns `String`: (no description: read it in its class)

## StepLog

- `StepLog.start()`: Starts a new test's log. BaseTest calls this before every test.
- `StepLog.step(String sentence)`: A step the test takes, as a visitor would say it: step("Type the email address").
- `StepLog.note(String remark)`: A remark that is not a step of its own, e.g. "now on the services page".
- `StepLog.steps()` returns `List<String>`: The steps so far, in order.
- `StepLog.reason(Throwable cause)` returns `String`: Why something failed, in one line. Playwright's errors start "Error {" with the reason on the lines below, then a call log of what it tried; this keeps the reason and the last thing the log says ("element is not visible", " intercepts pointer events").
- `StepLog.failure(Throwable cause)` returns `String`: What BaseTest prints when a test fails: the step it failed at, and why.

## For the generated code only

The generated classes use these; your own code uses the method each names instead.

- `UserActions.clickOn(Locator locator, String label)`: For the generated code (a family link found by its rebuilt address): in your own page code, click an element with click(page, element). Clicks the locator (Playwright waits for it to be shown and ready); when it cannot within the element timeout, says why in words, where Playwright's own error says only how long it waited.
- `UserActions.intoNewTab(Page page, String label, Runnable click)` returns `Page`: For the generated code: in your own page code, use clickOpeningNewTab(page, element). Runs a click that opens a new tab and returns the tab; when none opens, says where this tab went instead.
